intent: U17, the first batch after the UI overhaul programme: the review's three P1 findings, each a screen that does not work at 390. The header's actions took the title's row on Chat, Scripts and Skills, so the h1 read '(' and the subtitle went one word per line; Chat kept its 240px conversation list beside a 100px transcript; and three banners squeezed their sentence into a column beside their button. One class fixes the header on every screen; one primitive, SplitPane, gives Chat, Logs, Composer and Research the same two-column shape and the same phone shape; and every banner's action wraps under its sentence below sm. The phone gate learns to measure all three.

reasons.evidence: one primitive added, one header slot and four banners given a wrap, four pages moved onto the primitive, one picker's width and one scroll effect changed, one bubble widened; no route, no schema, no protected path; three oracle suites and three live measures new, two chat suites' dead polyfills removed

programme: U17, the review's P1 batch; follows U16 (T-0130) and the review at org/reviews/2026-09-ui-review.md. U18 (P2), U19 (P3) and U20 (P4) follow.
invariants: I1 A PHONE KEEPS THE PAGE'S NAME. Below sm the header's actions take their own row unconditionally; at 390 the h1's box is at least 12rem wide on every route and the subtitle runs to three lines at most (phone.spec).

I2 ONE TWO-COLUMN SHAPE. A list that chooses and the thing chosen is SplitPane: two columns from lg, the list behind a button below lg that opens a Dialog sheet and closes on the choice; the main pane carries data-ps-split=main and has at least 85% of main at 390.

I3 THE SENTENCE FIRST. A banner's action wraps under its words below sm (basis-full sm:basis-auto); the compact LoadErrorBanner's always does; every role=alert at 390 gives its words at least three fifths of its width with the button under them.
I4 THE TRANSCRIPT SCROLLS ITSELF. The chat's auto-scroll moves its own scroller and nothing above it; smoothness is CSS, which reduced motion turns off.

mutation: Fifteen mutants against the committed tree (69af48ee), each aimed at one decision: the header slot's basis-full, the split's breakpoint, the sheet closing on the choice, the opener's aria-expanded, the pane's mark, the sheet branch itself, the compact banner's always-wrap, the banner's flex-wrap, the drift button's basis, the drift line's controls, the bubble's Retry and its width, the transcript scrolling itself, the chat's closeOnChange, and the picker's width.
